description: This Java source file defines the ProviderAttribute class, which models a user-defined attribute associated with a Provider in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It extends a base attribute class and includes getter and setter methods for the attribute ID and the provider owner.

classes.name: ProviderAttribute
classes.description: A class representing a provider-specific attribute in the OpenMRS system, annotated for auditing, and providing getter and setter methods for attribute ID and owner (Provider).

methods.name: getProviderAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this provider attribute.

methods.name: setProviderAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this provider attribute.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the Provider entity associated with this attribute, utilizing the inherited getOwner() method.

methods.name: setProvider
methods.description: Associates a Provider entity with this attribute by calling setOwner().

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this attribute, delegated to getProviderAttributeId().

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of this attribute, delegated to setProviderAttributeId().
